description:
Embark on a unique and whimsical movement challenge known as Moonwalk Mayhem. In this extraordinary endeavor, your primary mode of locomotion is confined to the art of backpedaling. Embrace the retro dance-like motion as you navigate through captivating landscapes, unveiling secrets and facing unexpected encounters along the way. Traverse the world in reverse, defying convention and adding a touch of flair to your exploration. Moonwalk Mayhem encourages you to master the art of graceful retreat, unleashing your creativity and adaptability in the face of adversity. Get ready to groove your way through this enchanting journey of whimsy and wonder.

You have to walk backwards. The challenge is that you can only walk backwards.
name: Moonwalk Mayhem

rules.description: If you move forward or strafe you will fail this challenge.
rules.name: Backpedaling Only
